title.narrative: Number of direct beneficiaries (students in grades 1-4 benefitting from textbooks and teachers benefitting from training)
1st, 2nd, and 3rd grade teachers trained in how to effectively teach reading in national languages nationwide
French textbooks for 3rd and 4th grades distributed to schools nationwide
Reduction in public primary school fees paid by households in targeted provinces
Textbooks in science (2nd, 3rd, and 4th grades) distributed to schools nationwide
Textbooks in math (1st, 2nd, 3rd , and 4th grades) distributed to schools nationwide
Citizens' engagement: Share of school management plans co-signed by parent committees in targeted schools
Programs and related textbooks revised for elimination of stereotypes
Percentage of school directors in the project provinces trained in leadership (including classroom observation, school development plans)
Share of targeted schools receiving funds for including drop-out reduction in grade 1 as part of their management plan
Textbooks in reading (1st, 2nd, and 3rd grades) in national languages distributed to schools nationwide
Impact evaluation of PBF scheme on learning outcomes
One large-scale standardized student learning assessment undertaken
Establishment of the teacher training Directorate within MEPS-INC with clearly defined institutional mandate in coordination with the Ministry of Civil Service
Independent Unit for Learning Assessment (IULA) created and functional
Inter-school pedagogical training networks (réseaux d' écoles de proximité - REP) in the project provinces meet regularly
More than 70% of textbooks distributed to the schools before the start of the targeted school year
Sector annual reviews organized by SPACE
Semi-annual communication campaigns to prevent violence against females and early child marriage
Teacher training: MEPST elaborates a pre-service teacher training policy and a budgeted action plan
Implementation of standardized class observation method
Citizens’ Engagement: Share of schools receiving textbooks where parent or student representative confirms receipt
Percentage of 4th grade students with a mathematics textbook in targeted provinces
Percentage of 2nd grade students with a reading textbook in targeted provinces
Percentage of 2nd grade teachers in targeted provinces who report having and frequently utilizing a teachers’ guide for reading
